CDM — Create Digital Music.title: Free Friday: GForce’s superb Axxess instrument is free until December
CDM — Create Digital Music.description:
GForce has updated their site, branding, and pricing (now with both lifetime licenses and subscription options). And there are two freebies, time-limited through the end of November: a Mellotron M400 instrument, and the one I suspect most readers will be into, GForce's take on the 1975 ARP Axxe synthesizer.

The post Free Friday: GForce’s superb Axxess instrument is free until December appeared first on CDM Create Digital Music.

CDM — Create Digital Music.title: Free Friday: D16 is turning 20 and they’ve got a new free stereo delay
CDM — Create Digital Music.description:
Straight outta Katowice, our friends at D16 Audio Group are celebrating 20 years with an all-new stereo delay: Echolite. And don't let the "lite" in the name deceive you: this all-new giveaway has some power beneath its simple UI.

The post Free Friday: D16 is turning 20 and they’ve got a new free stereo delay appeared first on CDM Create Digital Music.

CDM — Create Digital Music.title: Roland TR-1000 1.5: keyboard mode, seamless kit switching, more
CDM — Create Digital Music.description:
Roland has one more announcement -- a 1.5 update for its flagship TR-1000 drum machine. That includes note sequencing, a must-requested keyboard mode for playing bass and melodic parts on the gear, the ability to swap patterns and kits with effects on without a hitch, and a lot of tweaks and UI improvements.

The post Roland TR-1000 1.5: keyboard mode, seamless kit switching, more appeared first on CDM Create Digital Music.

CDM — Create Digital Music.title: The world is your modular: Mulch Box, an all-jacks patch bay and multiplier
CDM — Create Digital Music.description:
It's the size of a standard guitar pedal. It needs no power It's... covered in jacks. It's Mulch Box, the first hardware from Go Outside, and it's a stunningly simple idea for signal routing any of your gear, minijack and full-sized jack alike.

The post The world is your modular: Mulch Box, an all-jacks patch bay and multiplier appeared first on CDM Create Digital Music.

CDM — Create Digital Music.title: Arturia’s new MiniFreak 49 synth is tactile, exploration-friendly: tested
CDM — Create Digital Music.description:
It's not just some extra keys or minor feature tweaks. Arturia's MiniFreak 49 has evolved the range into a synthesizer you can freely explore just by playing, not programming. It's a fusion of tactile experience and sound, right when we need that. Here's a full hands-on test.

The post Arturia’s new MiniFreak 49 synth is tactile, exploration-friendly: tested appeared first on CDM Create Digital Music.

CDM — Create Digital Music.title: Baby Roland is back: Boutique JUPITER-08, n/vision wavetable synths
CDM — Create Digital Music.description:
The kawaii look of the mini Rolands in the Boutique series has returned. There's one vintage remake -- the JUPITER-08, this time with full polyphony and then some (up to 32 voices). And there's something new: the n/vision wavetable synth.

The post Baby Roland is back: Boutique JUPITER-08, n/vision wavetable synths appeared first on CDM Create Digital Music.

CDM — Create Digital Music.title: Abed Eyad is making beats in Gaza: interview, call for support
CDM — Create Digital Music.description:
20-year-old Palestinian producer Abed Eyad is making beats from the rubble, surviving amidst genocide. He talks to us about what that's like, what drives his productions, and how to support his music.

The post Abed Eyad is making beats in Gaza: interview, call for support appeared first on CDM Create Digital Music.

CDM — Create Digital Music.title: The myth of Drexciya is coming to the Toronto Biennial — with playlist
CDM — Create Digital Music.description:
The myth of Drexciya is getting its moment at the Toronto Biennial, as retold by Underground Resistance. That's free through December 20th if you're in Ontario, but let's kick off a watery weekend with the accompanying playlist, too, courtesy UR and Sumberge label manager Cornelius Harris.

The post The myth of Drexciya is coming to the Toronto Biennial — with playlist appeared first on CDM Create Digital Music.

CDM — Create Digital Music.title: teenage engineering op-xy added a drum synth, sound shaping, more
CDM — Create Digital Music.description:
teenage engineering, the company that made news for slipping in an interview that it isn’t making new synths (maybe), might also make news for making its synths do new things. There’s an official (not hacked!) firmware update for the op-xy flagship, and it adds a new drum synth, multichannel audio, dynamic filter, and detune. The […]

CDM — Create Digital Music.title: Digital sound, but physical: Roger Linn’s LinnStrument in action, 10% off
CDM — Create Digital Music.description:
No, we do not all want to be reduced to brains in a jar. Music has always been about gesture, whether embodied in the breath or touch. So now is the perfect time for the LinnStrument, the human-scaled expressive grid from Roger Linn. Roger writes to point us to some of the latest musical examples […]
